26/**
27 * <p>Represents a polynomial whose coefficients are elements of a GF.
28 * Instances of this class are immutable.</p>
29 *
30 * <p>Much credit is due to William Rucklidge since portions of this code are an indirect
31 * port of his C++ Reed-Solomon implementation.</p>
32 *
33 * @author Sean Owen
34 */
35#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
36pub struct GenericGFPoly {
37    field: GenericGFRef,
38    coefficients: Vec<i32>,
39}
40
41impl GenericGFPoly {
42    /**
43     * @param field the {@link GenericGF} instance representing the field to use
44     * to perform computations
45     * @param coefficients coefficients as ints representing elements of GF(size), arranged
46     * from most significant (highest-power term) coefficient to least significant
47     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if argument is null or empty,
48     * or if leading coefficient is 0 and this is not a
49     * constant polynomial (that is, it is not the monomial "0")
50     */
51    pub fn new(field: GenericGFRef, coefficients: &[i32]) -> Result<Self> {
52        if coefficients.is_empty() {
53            return Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with(
54                "coefficients cannot be empty",
55            ));
56        }
57        Ok(Self {
58            field,
59            coefficients: {
60                let coefficients_length = coefficients.len();
61                if coefficients_length > 1 && coefficients[0] == 0 {
62                    // Leading term must be non-zero for anything except the constant polynomial "0"
63                    let mut first_non_zero = 1;
64                    while first_non_zero < coefficients_length && coefficients[first_non_zero] == 0
65                    {
66                        first_non_zero += 1;
67                    }
68                    if first_non_zero == coefficients_length {
69                        vec![0]
70                    } else {
71                        let mut new_coefficients = vec![0; coefficients_length - first_non_zero];
72                        let l = new_coefficients.len() - 1;
73                        new_coefficients[0..=l].clone_from_slice(&coefficients[first_non_zero..]);
74                        // System.arraycopy(coefficients,
75                        //     firstNonZero,
76                        //     this.coefficients,
77                        //     0,
78                        //     this.coefficients.length);
79                        new_coefficients
80                    }
81                } else {
82                    coefficients.to_vec()
83                }
84            },
85        })
86    }
87
88    pub fn getCoefficients(&self) -> &Vec<i32> {
89        &self.coefficients
90    }
91
92    /**
93     * @return degree of this polynomial
94     */
95    pub fn getDegree(&self) -> usize {
96        self.coefficients.len() - 1
97    }
98
99    /**
100     * @return true iff this polynomial is the monomial "0"
101     */
102    pub fn isZero(&self) -> bool {
103        self.coefficients[0] == 0
104    }
105
106    /**
107     * @return coefficient of x^degree term in this polynomial
108     */
109    pub fn getCoefficient(&self, degree: usize) -> i32 {
110        self.coefficients[self.coefficients.len() - 1 - degree]
111    }
112
113    /**
114     * @return evaluation of this polynomial at a given point
115     */
116    pub fn evaluateAt(&self, a: usize) -> i32 {
117        if a == 0 {
118            // Just return the x^0 coefficient
119            return self.getCoefficient(0);
120        }
121        if a == 1 {
122            // Just the sum of the coefficients
123            let mut result = 0;
124            for coefficient in &self.coefficients {
125                //for (int coefficient : coefficients) {
126                result = GenericGF::addOrSubtract(result, *coefficient);
127            }
128            return result;
129        }
130        let mut result = self.coefficients[0];
131        let size = self.coefficients.len();
132        for i in 1..size {
133            //for (int i = 1; i < size; i++) {
134            result = GenericGF::addOrSubtract(
135                self.field.multiply(a as i32, result),
136                self.coefficients[i],
137            );
138        }
139        result
140    }
141
142    pub fn addOrSubtract(&self, other: &GenericGFPoly) -> Result<GenericGFPoly> {
143        if self.field != other.field {
144            return Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with(
145                "GenericGFPolys do not have same GenericGF field",
146            ));
147        }
148        if self.isZero() {
149            return Ok(other.clone());
150        }
151        if other.isZero() {
152            return Ok(self.clone());
153        }
154
155        let mut smallerCoefficients = self.coefficients.clone();
156        let mut largerCoefficients = other.coefficients.clone();
157        if smallerCoefficients.len() > largerCoefficients.len() {
158            std::mem::swap(&mut smallerCoefficients, &mut largerCoefficients)
159        }
160
161        let mut sumDiff = vec![0; largerCoefficients.len()];
162        let lengthDiff = largerCoefficients.len() - smallerCoefficients.len();
163        // Copy high-order terms only found in higher-degree polynomial's coefficients
164        sumDiff[0..lengthDiff].clone_from_slice(&largerCoefficients[0..lengthDiff]);
165        //System.arraycopy(largerCoefficients, 0, sumDiff, 0, lengthDiff);
166
167        for i in lengthDiff..largerCoefficients.len() {
168            //for (int i = lengthDiff; i < largerCoefficients.length; i++) {
169            sumDiff[i] = GenericGF::addOrSubtract(
170                smallerCoefficients[i - lengthDiff],
171                largerCoefficients[i],
172            );
173        }
174
175        GenericGFPoly::new(self.field, &sumDiff)
176    }
177
178    pub fn multiply(&self, other: &GenericGFPoly) -> Result<GenericGFPoly> {
179        if self.field != other.field {
180            //if (!field.equals(other.field)) {
181            return Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with(
182                "GenericGFPolys do not have same GenericGF field",
183            ));
184        }
185        if self.isZero() || other.isZero() {
186            return Ok(self.getZero());
187        }
188        let aCoefficients = self.coefficients.clone();
189        let aLength = aCoefficients.len();
190        let bCoefficients = other.coefficients.clone();
191        let bLength = bCoefficients.len();
192        let mut product = vec![0; aLength + bLength - 1];
193        for i in 0..aLength {
194            //for (int i = 0; i < aLength; i++) {
195            let aCoeff = aCoefficients[i];
196            for j in 0..bLength {
197                //for (int j = 0; j < bLength; j++) {
198                product[i + j] = GenericGF::addOrSubtract(
199                    product[i + j],
200                    self.field.multiply(aCoeff, bCoefficients[j]),
201                );
202            }
203        }
204        GenericGFPoly::new(self.field, &product)
205    }
206
207    pub fn multiply_with_scalar(&self, scalar: i32) -> GenericGFPoly {
208        if scalar == 0 {
209            return self.getZero();
210        }
211        if scalar == 1 {
212            return self.clone();
213        }
214        let size = self.coefficients.len();
215
216        let mut product = vec![0; size];
217        for (i, prod) in product.iter_mut().enumerate().take(size) {
218            // for i in 0..size {
219            //for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
220            *prod = self.field.multiply(self.coefficients[i], scalar);
221        }
222        GenericGFPoly::new(self.field, &product).unwrap()
223    }
224
225    pub fn getZero(&self) -> Self {
226        GenericGFPoly::new(self.field, &[0]).unwrap()
227    }
228
229    pub fn getOne(&self) -> Self {
230        GenericGFPoly::new(self.field, &[1]).unwrap()
231    }
232
233    pub fn multiply_by_monomial(&self, degree: usize, coefficient: i32) -> Result<GenericGFPoly> {
234        if coefficient == 0 {
235            return Ok(self.getZero());
236        }
237        let size = self.coefficients.len();
238        let mut product = vec![0; size + degree];
239        for (i, prod) in product.iter_mut().enumerate().take(size) {
240            // for i in 0..size {
241            //for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
242            *prod = self.field.multiply(self.coefficients[i], coefficient);
243        }
244        GenericGFPoly::new(self.field, &product)
245    }
246
247    pub fn divide(&self, other: &GenericGFPoly) -> Result<(GenericGFPoly, GenericGFPoly)> {
248        if self.field != other.field {
249            return Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with(
250                "GenericGFPolys do not have same GenericGF field",
251            ));
252        }
253        if other.isZero() {
254            return Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with("Divide by 0"));
255        }
256
257        let mut quotient = self.getZero();
258        let mut remainder = self.clone();
259
260        let denominator_leading_term = other.getCoefficient(other.getDegree());
261        let inverse_denominator_leading_term = match self.field.inverse(denominator_leading_term) {
262            Ok(val) => val,
263            Err(_issue) => return Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with("arithmetic issue")),
264        };
265
266        while remainder.getDegree() >= other.getDegree() && !remainder.isZero() {
267            let degree_difference = remainder.getDegree() - other.getDegree();
268            let scale = self.field.multiply(
269                remainder.getCoefficient(remainder.getDegree()),
270                inverse_denominator_leading_term,
271            );
272            let term = other.multiply_by_monomial(degree_difference, scale)?;
273            let iteration_quotient = GenericGF::buildMonomial(self.field, degree_difference, scale);
274            quotient = quotient.addOrSubtract(&iteration_quotient)?;
275            remainder = remainder.addOrSubtract(&term)?;
276        }
277
278        Ok((quotient, remainder))
279    }
280}
281
282impl fmt::Display for GenericGFPoly {
283    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
284        if self.isZero() {
285            return write!(f, "0");
286        }
287        let mut result = String::with_capacity(8 * self.getDegree());
288        for degree in (0..=self.getDegree()).rev() {
289            //for (int degree = getDegree(); degree >= 0; degree--) {
290            let mut coefficient = self.getCoefficient(degree);
291            if coefficient != 0 {
292                if coefficient < 0 {
293                    if degree == self.getDegree() {
294                        result.push('-');
295                    } else {
296                        result.push_str(" - ");
297                    }
298                    coefficient = -coefficient;
299                } else if !result.is_empty() {
300                    result.push_str(" + ");
301                }
302                if degree == 0 || coefficient != 1 {
303                    if let Ok(alpha_power) = self.field.log(coefficient) {
304                        if alpha_power == 0 {
305                            result.push('1');
306                        } else if alpha_power == 1 {
307                            result.push('a');
308                        } else {
309                            result.push_str("a^");
310                            result.push_str(&format!("{alpha_power}"));
311                        }
312                    }
313                }
314                if degree != 0 {
315                    if degree == 1 {
316                        result.push('x');
317                    } else {
318                        result.push_str("x^");
319                        result.push_str(&format!("{degree}"));
320                    }
321                }
322            }
323        }
324        write!(f, "{result}")
325    }
